description: This file contains functions and type definitions for managing SSH sandbox sessions, including creating, disposing, and executing commands over SSH, as well as uploading directories securely. It handles SSH configuration, command building, and process spawning.

methods.name: normalizeInlineSshMaterial
methods.description: Normalizes SSH key material contents by removing BOM, normalizing newlines, and expanding escaped newlines based on filename.

methods.name: buildSshFailureMessage
methods.description: Constructs a user-friendly error message based on SSH stderr output and exit code, especially handling crypto errors.

methods.name: shellEscape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe use in shell commands by wrapping in single quotes and escaping internal quotes.

methods.name: buildRemoteCommand
methods.description: Builds a shell command string from an array of arguments, shell-escaping each.

methods.name: buildExecRemoteCommand
methods.description: Constructs a remote execution command string with optional working directory and environment variables.

methods.name: buildSshSandboxArgv
methods.description: Creates an argument array for SSH command, including config, host, and TTY options.

methods.name: createSshSandboxSessionFromConfigText
methods.description: Creates an SSH sandbox session from provided SSH config text, writing config to a temporary file.

methods.name: createSshSandboxSessionFromSettings
methods.description: Creates an SSH sandbox session from settings, generating SSH config with proper keys and options.

methods.name: disposeSshSandboxSession
methods.description: Removes temporary SSH config directory associated with a session.

methods.name: runSshSandboxCommand
methods.description: Executes an SSH command in the sandbox, capturing output and handling errors.

methods.name: uploadDirectoryToSshTarget
methods.description: Uploads a local directory to the SSH target securely, ensuring symlinks do not escape the workspace.

methods.name: assertSafeUploadSymlinks
methods.description: Recursively verifies that symlinks in the directory do not escape the root directory.

methods.name: parseSshConfigHost
methods.description: Extracts the Host name from SSH config text.

methods.name: resolveSshTmpRoot
methods.description: Resolves the temporary directory root for SSH operations.

methods.name: resolveOptionalLocalPath
methods.description: Resolves a user path if provided, or returns undefined.

methods.name: writeSecretMaterial
methods.description: Writes SSH key or certificate material to a file with proper permissions.
